scope.pairing: The same 175 task IDs, judge, prompt contract, and candidate indices are used in both sealed F2 arms.

token_count_transport_retries.scope: The free, idempotent token-count endpoint only; transient connection, timeout, rate-limit, and provider-5xx errors. Paid batch creation still uses an ambiguity-safe single attempt.

request_contract.connection_warmup: A free models.list request on the same client precedes token counting and must attest that the exact target model ID is present.
request_contract.over_input_cap_action: fail_closed_before_any_paid_evaluation_call; never truncate a sealed F2 input

thinking.note: max_tokens is a hard combined limit for thinking plus final response, so this is a budgeted high-effort operating point, not an unrestricted model ceiling.

request_contract.output_instruction: Return only the final Dart source. Do not serialize reasoning.

sequential_k_schedule.run_condition: only when the predeclared BAD gate is true

bad_gate.evaluate_only_after: all 700 logical S1+S2 Sonnet responses are terminal
bad_gate.sonnet_arm_solve_count: For each arm, count held-out tasks with at least one completion-attested pass among its two primary 8192-token Sonnet candidates. Tests remain hidden from the model.
bad_gate.calibration: At x=9 of n=175, the one-sided 97.5% Clopper-Pearson upper bound is approximately 9.538%; using 97.5% per arm gives a simultaneous 95% statement that at least one arm is below a 10% pass@2 utility floor.
bad_gate.if_bad: Run O1 for every task in both arms. Never select only Sonnet failures.
bad_gate.if_not_bad: Stop after S2 and make no claim about Opus 5.
bad_gate.scoring: Refusal, malformed output, compile failure, judge failure, or primary stop_reason=max_tokens is unsolved. Retry only unbilled transport/batch errors at the same logical slot.

length_retry_ladder.execution_order: Run capacity repairs only after the BAD decision and, when BAD is true, only after O1 completes. Never spend retry headroom before reserving every triggered base stage.
length_retry_ladder.financial_gate: Before submitting a repair rung, reserve every still-mandatory base stage and calculate the worst-case cost for every pending length slot at that rung. Submit the complete rung only if total worst-case experiment spend remains <= 99.00 USD; otherwise submit none of that rung.
length_retry_ladder.primary_metric: Primary fixed-cap metrics always retain the original 8192-token outcome, with length counted as failure.
length_retry_ladder.adaptive_metric: A separate capacity-adaptive metric may replace same-slot length outcomes only when every observed length slot for that reported model has a terminal non-length result. Partial repair coverage is diagnostic only and must not enter an aggregate pass@k.
length_retry_ladder.exhausted_ladder_action: If 65536 also ends at max_tokens, retain failure and mark capacity_exhausted; do not add another rung.

budget.invalid_after_pricing_deadline: Re-price and reseal before running after 2026-08-31. At announced post-intro Sonnet Batch pricing, the full base schedule exceeds 100 USD.

report_separately: Sonnet pass@1 and pass@2 by arm
Opus pass@1 by arm when O1 is triggered
compile rates, refusals, malformed outputs, and max_tokens stops by model and arm
paired arm discordances and paired confidence intervals
forbidden_pooling: Never pool Sonnet and Opus candidates into pass@3 or any pass@k.
Never pool the two enrichment arms.
Never call selectively repaired length slots a complete adaptive metric.
Never present gated Opus results as an unconditional, preplanned Opus-versus-Sonnet confirmatory test.
analysis_contract.optional_cascade_metric: The union of Sonnet and gated Opus successes may be reported only as a separately named deployment-policy cascade success rate, never as pass@k.
